name: Terror Bomb (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Alchemist 8

Benefit: The alchemist can create a bomb containing psychotropic chemicals that instill fear in those exposed to it. A creature hit directly by the bomb must make a Will save or become frightened for 2d4 rounds. A creature caught in the splash area must make a Will save or be shaken for 1d4 rounds instead. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
